name: plan-coverage
body: The coverage rule of the plan-verify gate: the obligation set is exactly the changed `implemented-by` claims of the branch's durable-spec delta, and each affected code FQN is touched by a plan task. The same delta scopes the requirement gate: every requirement added or changed in the delta is `Satisfies`'d by at least one plan phase. Coverage is verb-agnostic, counts a `renames`/`moves` destination, and compares code FQNs by language-agnostic identity. An in-scope solution node whose `implemented-by` claim is absent is reported as a `no_claims` warning.
